Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.agent

Class AbstractBehaviorStrategy

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.agent.AbstractBehaviorStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
BehaviorStrategy, Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
CalmEvacuationStrategy, FrozenStrategy, LeaderFollowStrategy, PanickedEvacuationStrategy
public abstract class AbstractBehaviorStrategy extends Object implements BehaviorStrategy
Base class shared by the concrete behaviour strategies.

It gathers geometric helpers (nearest exit, Euclidean distance) and a simple greedy move toward the closest exit, reused by several strategies and as a fallback when no precomputed route is available yet.

Version:
1.0
Author:
GROUPE E
